name: review-skills
description: Review skills: /run-code-review runs a thorough, evidence-based code review of a PR, diff, files or repo at a staff engineer's bar and returns a structured report (verdict, findings by severity with file and line, suggested code changes), with per-language checklists, security scope and review wisdom for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, shell, PowerShell, SQL, HTML, CSS, Markdown, XML, JSON, YAML and TOML. Options choose the languages (-l), the files (-p, -t, --local, -r, --base) and a security-only review (-s); -o writes it as a self-contained HTML page, Markdown or JSON with each finding linked to its line on GitHub or GitLab.
